task: vibebelt-rebrand Phase 6: vc- to vb- prefix rename and upgrade safety
note: Paths are the names after the rename commit; line numbers were measured after the apply (the rename does not change line counts). Every surface that can delete or rewrite files is listed.

snippets.description: PROTECTED: the one definition of the protected set (task folder segment, .git, node_modules, tool + fixtures + allowlists, legacy-hashes.json, CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATION.md, .agents/skills, legacyDeletions key, legacy-vc-fallback tag, keep-region markers)
the 7 explicit rules; preceder rule: not ASCII [A-Za-z0-9] or the literal two characters \n (so dvc- is never touched)
line-level protections: keep-regions (unterminated region = stop before writing), legacyDeletions state machine in *manifest.json, tagged lines
makeInsideRoot: no ancestor may be a symlink and the real parent must stay inside the real root; files are read with lstat and never followed
apply: refuses a dirty tree outside the task folder (exit 3, nothing written); every check runs before the first write; contents first, then renames deepest first

shared legacy gate: loadLegacyHashes, readPriorSnapshot (new name first, old name second), isLegacyGated, decideLegacy (hashed -> delete iff sha256 equal; snapshotGated -> all files in snapshot; unknown/modified/odd/no snapshot/no hashes -> keep and report; paths the kit still ships are skipped)
computeSyncPlan uses the gate at step 3 (stale snapshot files) and step 4 (legacyDeletions), before the namespace check
applyPlan removes the old state files only after both new ones were written
--legacy-gate CLI: the install.sh interface (one decision line per file, writes nothing)
gate_run / gate_decide / is_gated / apply_gate (bash 3 compatible); when the gate cannot run, old-prefix paths are kept (fail closed)
the two deletion sites (stale removal and legacyDeletions) consult the gate before their own rm
old env variable, manifest and state-file fallbacks; old state files removed after both new files were written
config lookup .vb.json > .vc.json > .ck.json (local and global); same chain in .codex/hooks/lib/vb-config-utils.cjs with the Claude-era slots
